G1_unambiguity.justification: The vector-space condition and catalog-selection objective have a single clear interpretation, with any ambiguity about equal priority indices being immaterial because the resulting vector is zero.

G2_completeness.justification: All necessary bounds, input formats, field definitions, feasibility guarantees, output requirements, and the single-priority edge case are specified.

G3_faithfulness.justification: Over GF(2), selected vectors span the required pairwise differences exactly when the corresponding selected edges place all priority sites in one connected component, so the optimization problem is equivalent to the original.

G4_naturalness.justification: The statement is coherent and readable, though the abstract procurement and vector-space framing is somewhat contrived compared with the original cabling formulation.
